title: 13 Best Herbal Teas For Difficult Speaking
description: Achillea millefolium teas, also known as yarrow tea, have been traditionally used to treat aphasia, a difficult speaking ailment characterized by impaired speech and language. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties of this herbal preparation help to reduce inflammation and promote healing in the brain, thereby improving communication skills.
